newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission says eight green rates devalue Monday.
newsitem.headline: Commission says eight green rates devalue Monday.

text.p: The green rates of the Belgian franc, German mark, Dutch Guilder, Danish crown, French franc, Spanish peseta, Portuguese escudo and Austrian schilling will be devalued on Monday, the European Commission confirmed.
The green Belgian franc will devalue to 40.8741 per Ecu from 40.7357. The green mark will devalue to 1.97970 per Ecu from 1.97407 and the green guilder will devalue to 2.22893 per Ecu from 2.22212.

The green Danish crown will devalue to 7.54258 per Ecu from 7.51757, the green French franc to 6.68769 per Ecu from 6.65716, the green Spanish peseta to 166.839 per Ecu from 166.718 and the green Escudo to 199.837 per Ecu from 199.234.
And the green Austrian schilling will devalue to 13.9291 per Ecu from 13.8905.
The devaluations were forecast earlier on Friday by the U.K.'s Home Grown Cereals Authority.
Green rates are used by the European Union to convert Ecus into the currencies of its member states in its Common Agricultural Policy.
